content.title: Teucrium’s Sal Gilbertie on What Investors Miss in the Ags
content.summary: Teucrium's Sal Gilbertie offers unique perspective and expertise on two divergent markets: agriculture and crypto. Find out what commodities are an overlooked, under-allocated portfolio stabilizer in challenging markets. On the digital asset side, learn about the explosive potential of XRP and the XRPL for global finance.

content.title: Spotlight on Agricultural ETFs as China Buys 1M Tons of US Soyabeans
content.summary: China's purchase of over 1M tons of U.S. soybeans revives ag-sector optimism and puts ETFs like SOYB, PDBA, and TILL in sharper focus.

content.title: Soybean Prices Take a Breather After Report Says China Is Buying
content.summary: Prices of soybeans, as measured by a contract with the closest expiration date, have fallen by 0.3%.  The Teucrium Soybean Fund, which tracks soybean futures, is down by a similar amount.  The small loss comes after prices of soybeans rose by 5.1% over the past month and 11% over the past three months.

content.title: Agricultural ETFs to Gain With U.S.-China Trade Truce on the Horizon
content.summary: Trade truce hopes lift agricultural ETFs like SOYB, CORN, and TAGS, signaling a potential rebound for the U.S. farm sector.

content.title: Struggling US Farm ETFs Face New Threat: China Tariffs
content.summary: New retaliatory measures targeting $21 billion in agricultural exports deepen losses for commodity funds already seeing outflows.
